input.name: Responsive browser layout
input.requirement: All widgets adapt to browser size and resize without loss of function.

output.target: No clipped primary controls; local scroll only where necessary.

input.name: Container backward compatibility
input.requirement: Older local snapshots shall not break rendering after schema upgrades.

output.target: Graceful migration or fallback to embedded defaults.

input.name: Risk Matrix drill-down
input.requirement: Matrix cells shall display risk counts and open risks belonging to the selected S/O cell.

input.name: Time-based risk trajectory
input.requirement: Risk trajectory shall support lifecycle and calendar time with selectable ranges.

output.target: Lifecycle, day/week/month range and From/To filtering.

input.name: Traceable AI recommendations
input.requirement: Every AI recommendation shall identify source records and be user-confirmed before authoritative changes.

input.name: Offline single-file runtime
input.requirement: Core FMEA functionality shall remain usable without an AI service or internet connection.

input.name: Change Impact temporal analysis
input.requirement: Change Impact shall provide legends and day/week time views.

output.target: Legend values and selectable temporal buckets.

input.name: Cross-module object identity
input.requirement: A single characteristic/failure/cause/control object shall be reused across all views.

input.failure_mode: Only static shell renders; dashboard/navigation content missing.
input.cause: Older browser snapshot overwrote newer embedded data structure; required arrays were absent.

output.action: Schema merge/migration with default fallback and render error boundary.
output.result: Newer versions tolerate older snapshots and surface diagnostics instead of white screen.
lessons: Never replace new schema wholesale with old local snapshot.
Validate and migrate before render.
Keep reset/recovery path.

input.failure_mode: Risk matrix visualized risk zones but did not show how many risks were in a cell or which risks they were.
input.cause: Mockup-focused rendering without data-driven bucket aggregation.

output.action: Aggregate DFMEA/PFMEA by S/O, show count badge, drill down to filtered records.
output.result: Matrix is now a live view of FMEA data rather than a decorative heatmap.
lessons: Every visualization must drill down to source objects.
Count widgets must be computed from live data.

title: Risk trajectory had no selectable time basis

input.failure_mode: Trajectory showed lifecycle progression but could not answer time-window questions.
input.cause: Lifecycle mockup implemented without calendar query controls.

output.action: Add lifecycle/calendar mode, period selection and From/To dates.
output.result: Trajectory can support both development phase and calendar analysis.
lessons: Every trend needs an explicit time basis.
Timeline controls belong to the data query, not only to chart styling.

input.failure_mode: Widgets/matrices/tables do not fit when the browser is resized.
input.cause: Fixed grid widths and minimum sizes inherited from static mockups.

output.action: Responsive auto-fit grids, minmax(0,1fr), local overflow for dense data, breakpoints.
output.result: Primary UI adapts; dense tables/matrices use local scrolling where needed.
lessons: Mockup pixels are reference, not runtime constraints.
Responsive behavior is a software characteristic and testable requirement.

title: Change Impact charts lacked explanatory legends/time granularity

input.failure_mode: Charts were visually present but decision context was incomplete.
input.cause: Dashboard chart decoration implemented before explicit interpretation requirements.

output.action: Add legend with values/percentages and day/week temporal buckets.
output.result: Change Impact supports interpretation and temporal investigation.
lessons: A chart without legend/time basis can be misleading.
Dashboard acceptance criteria must include decision usability.

title: Mockup pages existed without complete functional behavior

input.failure_mode: Buttons/widgets look complete but actions do not modify or query shared data.
input.cause: Presentation layer developed ahead of universal action/transaction wiring.

output.action: Introduce shared CRUD, filters, transaction log, autosave, import/export and cross-module object links.
output.result: Open FMEA moves from dashboard prototype toward functional engineering application.
lessons: No dead controls.
All meaningful UI actions should map to commands/transactions.
Use shared engines instead of page-specific scripts.

title: GUI shell visible but workspace blank

input.failure_mode: Static shell renders while main application content fails to render.
input.cause: Version/schema/runtime integration regression; older state may override newer expected data shape.

output.action: Add migration/default merge, diagnostics and render error boundary.
lessons: Mockup is a controlled validation baseline.
GUI regression is a software failure mode.
Do not accept feature work without regression validation.

input.failure_mode: Widgets/buttons are visible but do not execute the expected data operation.
input.cause: Presentation implementation progressed faster than shared command/data-flow wiring.

lessons: Mockup is a controlled validation baseline.
GUI regression is a software failure mode.
Do not accept feature work without regression validation.

title: GUI regression after adding new functionality

input.failure_mode: A later build introduces features but moves away from supplied mockup layout or breaks previously accepted GUI behavior.
input.cause: No immutable per-page mockup baseline and no mandatory regression gate before release.

output.action: Treat every mockup as a validation baseline; every GUI change requires mockup parity + functional + responsive regression.
lessons: Mockup is a controlled validation baseline.
GUI regression is a software failure mode.
Do not accept feature work without regression validation.

title: Visualization not connected to decision drill-down

input.failure_mode: Risk matrix or chart exists visually but does not expose the underlying records or correct time interpretation.
input.cause: Visualization built as dashboard element rather than query over source-of-truth objects.

output.action: All visual widgets must be reversible to their source record set and explicit time basis.
lessons: Mockup is a controlled validation baseline.
GUI regression is a software failure mode.
Do not accept feature work without regression validation.

title: DFMEA view must remain aligned with controlled mockup while functionality evolves

input.failure_mode: Feature additions alter DFMEA layout or remove expected mockup widgets/functions.
input.cause: No page-specific controlled baseline gate during implementation.

output.action: Lock DFMEA mockup as validation baseline and implement alternate DFMEA functions over the same shared records.
output.result: DFMEA development now requires visual + functional + responsive regression validation.
lessons: Do not trade mockup parity for new feature work.
Tabs are alternate views, not duplicate data stores.
Every DFMEA chart must derive from current source records.

title: Shared navigation, DFMEA stabilization and traceable analysis learning

input.failure_mode: DFMEA/PFMEA regressions and analysis output disconnected from learning
input.cause: View-specific implementation and incomplete shared commands

output.action: Use one embedded runtime with shared navigation, data queries, audit snapshots, structured analyses and in-browser diagnostics.
output.result: Development checks pass; in-browser diagnostics report four legacy data failure categories. Exact visual acceptance and other legacy pages remain pending.
lessons: Keep application and validation logic in one HTML.
Preserve historical engineering values until reviewed.
Keep drafts separate from approved learning.

provenance.review_status: Draft — engineering and visual review pending

title: Home dashboard acceptance requires source data and feature-level validation

input.failure_mode: A rendered dashboard can retain hard-coded values, missing baseline panels and dead controls
input.cause: Home was not validated against a controlled feature acceptance matrix

output.action: Restore baseline panel hierarchy, query shared records, add source drill-down and validate commands, persistence and task scope
output.result: Functional correction tested; controlled visual acceptance remains pending
lessons: Use feature-level acceptance, not page counts, to assess completion.
Do not publish fixed example values as live dashboard results.
Scope UI tests to the requested page.

title: Water ingress / seal failure investigation
problem: Water ingress detected during environmental testing.

Man: Seal installation technique varies by operator
Machine: Fixture does not positively locate seal
Method: No explicit visual confirmation before release

whyChain: Why did water enter the housing? — Seal did not provide full contact.
Why was full contact missing? — Seal was locally under-compressed.
Why was compression insufficient? — Assembly position varied.
Why could position vary? — Fixture permits positional tolerance.
Why was this not detected? — No poka-yoke / in-line verification existed.

title: Incorrect weld / reduced joint strength
whyChain: Why was weld strength low? — Heat input was below target.
Why was heat input below target? — Parameter set was incorrect.
Why was the wrong set used? — Recipe selection was not interlocked to product variant.
